200.description: SSE data contains LlmEvent; completion or failure is required

parameters.name: ordinal
parameters.description: Optional candidate ordinal; returns newest first, with after as an exclusive upper sequence bound.

parameters.name: disposition
parameters.description: active, needs_review, rejudge, or excluded; omitted returns all dispositions

parameters.name: max_source_bytes
parameters.description: Cold generation input byte limit, at most 64 MiB

200.description: Authenticated image bytes; x-studio-cache, x-studio-freshness and x-studio-verified-ms report cache verification
Original stored bytes, at most 64 MiB

parameters.name: include_pinterest
parameters.description: Explicit opt-in; absent/false preserves the legacy set of source families.

AestheticAnalysisPlace.description: `first` and `last` take no target; `before` and `after` place the job next to `target`.

action.description: retry, reparse, or defer. Reparse is handled by the engine.

batches.description: Empty means all matching batches at the operation's frozen upper bound.

items.description: Bounded results of the most recently processed page.

model.description: Credential-free, resolved configuration; contains no image bytes.

AestheticEngineStatus.description: Engine-wide aesthetic execution limits shared by every project.

kind.description:
davidson_v1 (diagonal solver), davidson_v2 (bounded L-BFGS), or borda_v1.
Both Davidson versions use the same batch-normalized composite objective.

batch_timeout_ms.description: Wall-clock recovery budget, starting at the first network dispatch.

exhausted.description: pause or defer; defer closes failed logical batches without accepting evidence.

failure_halt_threshold.description: Consecutive failed network attempts that halt dispatch; absent uses concurrency clamped to 4–32.

image_max_edge.description: API image longest edge (128–8192); absent keeps original bytes. May change between attempts.

memory_budget_mib.description: Per-stage request preparation memory budget; absent uses 512 MiB.

upload_bytes_per_second.description: Request admission pacing by serialized body bytes; 0 disables pacing, absent uses 3.5 MB/s.

stability_seed.description: Refit two deterministic, disjoint sets of whole batches. Not a confidence interval.

include_protected.description:
Union protected candidates into the selection after quality filters;
Rating and year restrictions still apply.

position.description: Pagination position only, never a cross-Rating/global aesthetic rank.

decision.description: protect, confirm_elite, release, defer. Decisions never change statistical scores.

distinct_opponents.description: Exact count, capped at 32; not a count of independent judgments.

rank_sensitivity.description: Whole-batch influence sensitivity in percentile units, not a confidence interval.

mode.description: balanced or adaptive; both use frozen rounds and cross-batch mixing.

rank_tolerance.description: Maximum consecutive percentile movement for empirical stability (0..1).

start_cursor.description: Reusable first-page cursor after a Danbooru ID or ranking position has been located.

status.description: available, unlinked, preparing, unavailable, or unsupported.

store_root.description: Accepted for older clients; worker sources always come from Studio.

target_share.description: Thousandths of the final per-rating retained count. Null means soft preference only.

system_prompt_id.description: Optional saved System Prompt. Cannot be combined with system/developer messages.

text.description: Literal system instructions, preserved without trimming or variable substitution.

oneOf.description: Omitted means the order saved with the workset. This never changes membership.

start_post_id.description: Exact frozen Danbooru post ID; the located row is included as the first item.

start_rank.description:
Positive, one-based position in the current scope and viewing direction.
With start_rating, this is the original rank within that frozen Rating instead.
Mutually exclusive with start_post_id; the located member is included.

start_rating.description:
Frozen scoring Rating (g, s, q, e). Requires start_rank and a ranking order other than input.
Only locates a member; it does not filter or change the scope.

selection_reason.description: 0 none/main, 1 direct-only rescue, 2 era-only rescue, 3 random audit.

metadata_only.description: This release has no visual bridge calibration or inferred aesthetic probabilities.

path.description: Absolute file path chosen by the user; never inside an attached lake.

SetLakeCredentials.description: No Debug implementation: key material must never enter tracing.

StartCollectionLogin.description: Native login bridge: no Cookie or browser profile is exposed to the UI.
